HOW IT HELPS

How it works
in everyday life.

CITI brings local air quality information into your daily routine. Check the index before going outside or opening windows.

When it comes in handy

About to walk your dog or air out a room? Check the local index first to help decide when to do it.

Readings depend on the available monitoring stations and how often the source updates its data.
